requirements.title: Procedure reference form depends on interface, not definition mechanism
requirements.source: S15.5.1 p1, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF335.
requirements.definition: A procedure reference form depends on the procedure or procedure pointer interface and is independent of the means by which the procedure is defined; the following syntax rules enumerate the forms.

requirements.definition: C1544 disambiguates R1528: a consequent-arg represented through the expr alternative is not a variable; a bare variable consequent uses the variable alternative, while parenthesized (x) is an expression under R1001 and is not a variable for this constraint.

pending.conditional-consequent-variable-versus-e: Semantic plan uses two conforming companions. Expression alternative: call an INTENT(IN) dummy with (mask ? (x) : y), initialize x=5 and y=7, have the procedure read value 5 into a result sentinel initialized to -1, and assert x remains 5.
